decls.name: IsFiniteUnramifiedProPExt
decls.rationale: Pro-p group-theory plumbing behind the Frattini/Golod–Shafarevich statements of Section 3. Not a standalone paper statement.

decls.name: maxUnramifiedProPExt

paper_span.quote: the compositum of all finite everywhere-unramified Galois extensions of \(F\) whose Galois groups

decls.rationale: `maxUnramifiedProPExt p F` is the paper's \(F^{\mathrm{ur},p}\): the compositum of all finite everywhere-unramified Galois extensions of `F` with p-group Galois group.

decls.name: galUr

paper_span.quote: Its Galois group \(\operatorname{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},p}/F)\) is a pro-\(p\) group, and its finite quotients

decls.rationale: `galUr p F` is the paper's \(G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},p}/F)\), carrying the Krull topology, the pro-p group the whole tower argument runs in.

decls.name: fixedFieldOf

paper_span.quote: of open normal subgroups with indices tending to infinity, and let \(F_j\) be the corresponding fixed

decls.rationale: `fixedFieldOf H` gives the finite tower layer attached to an open normal subgroup — the paper's step "let \(F_j\) be the corresponding fixed fields".

decls.name: IsFrobeniusRepAt
decls.rationale: `IsFrobeniusRepAt σ q` formalizes the paper's *Frobenius representative* \(\sigma_v \in G\) in the infinite group \(G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},3}/F)\): a compatible system restricting to a Frobenius element on every finite Galois layer.
